description: This file defines macros and functions for implementing 'commit slab' data structures, including initialization, clearing, deep clearing, and accessors for slabs. It appears to assist in managing memory slabs for commit objects.

methods.name: init_<slabname>_with_stride
methods.description: Initializes a slab structure with a specified stride and calculates slab size.

methods.name: init_<slabname>
methods.description: Initializes a slab structure with default stride of 1.

methods.name: clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Clears all allocated slabs, freeing memory.

methods.name: deep_clear_<slabname>
methods.description: Performs a deep clear by freeing all elements within the slabs using a provided function.

methods.name: <slabname>_at_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit, optionally creating the slab if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_at
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit, creating the slab if missing.

methods.name: <slabname>_peek
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the element at a given commit without creating missing slabs.
